whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Aryan Dental Clinic,

I noticed your clinic has strong 4.5★ reviews in Mithapur, Patna, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for patient appointments and service inquiries.

Maine aapke dental clinic ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp consultation booking, dental treatments list, aur clinic timings integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/aryandental

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Aryan Dental Clinic team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke clinic ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? Great! We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp booking and mobile-first speed for patients searching in Mithapur. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact treatments, actual photos aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
